description.en: Plugins for Semdok Harness, made by Semdok.
Team mode: a lead agent splits big tasks across specialist agents (researcher, builder, reviewer, tester, writer) that work in parallel, then checks and merges their results.

Browse the web like a person: browser-use on your Semdok models drives a real Chrome or Edge window, waits for pages to load, and reports what it found. Works with Agent Team for several browsers at once.

Apps and data for the agent through MCP: Stripe, GitHub, Supabase, Linear and Notion with one saved key, plus read-only BigQuery with a cost cap, Databricks Genie and SQL, and Gmail read and drafts. Secrets never go through the chat.

Plan features before coding with Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model: brainstorm, draft a design document, and have fresh-context reviewer agents find its gaps. Commands /egm-brainstorm, /egm-draft and /egm-review.
Multi-agent stock and crypto research (TradingAgents by Tauric Research) on your Semdok models. Research only, not financial advice.
Add Sem, Semdok's 3D conversational assistant (live.semdok.com), to any website: HTML, React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow.
